howTo: Click Choose files and select one or more files from your device. Repeat to add more.
Remove any file you added by mistake with the X button next to it.
Type a name for the archive, for example project-backup.
Press Create ZIP and wait a moment while the files are compressed.
Your browser downloads the .zip file automatically. Open it with your system's built-in extractor.
keyFacts: Produces a genuine ZIP archive using the standard Deflate compression (method 8), readable by every operating system.
Files that do not compress well, such as already-compressed images or videos, are stored uncompressed so the archive never grows larger than the input.
File names support Unicode (UTF-8 flag), so names in Hindi, Arabic or any script survive intact.
A 300 MB total input cap keeps the tool fast and prevents the browser tab from running out of memory.
Each entry carries a CRC-32 checksum, so corrupted downloads are detected when you extract.

You select three files: notes.txt (1,200 bytes), data.csv (4,800 bytes) and photo.jpg (220,000 bytes).
